test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f3bdd91dfe97af407f31ae26ff5ed9bb51489c91f34fa27f51d2a73f1d54683.png] 

Which of the following statements is correct on the basis of the above diagram?

options.text: The number of teachers who are both writers and poets is 20.
The number of poets who are also teachers is 44.
The number of writers who are neither teachers nor poets is 10.
The number of poets who are also teachers but not writers is 48.

solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f3bdd91dfe97af407f31ae26ff5ed9bb51489c91f34fa27f51d2a73f1d54683.png] 

Now, 

**Option 1) ****The number of teachers who are both writers and poets is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15caeb62ad64fbec76f0dd98fb64c72cf2c0539f28d387d8d8a7cc2b42bee972.png] 

The shaded area shows the **"the number of teachers who are both writers and poets" = 20**.

Option 2) The number of poets who are also teachers is 44.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6af8fe2ec9fff0b496d8e8d79eb14102def75ecfb970a665554b585550d9059d.png] 

The shaded area shows the "The number of poets who are also teachers".

Option 3) The number of writers who are neither teachers nor poets is 10.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc1195286eba75a5f11fda90a5470b4d702a939ce2e6eb51df801268a14d973b.png] 

The shaded area shows the " The number of writers who are neither teachers nor poets".

Option 4) The number of poets who are also teachers but not writers is 48.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3290c93f1bcd57067b19a2e5a04ca0774f1d480fe681361dc9133683041b8fe2.png] 

The shaded area shows the "The number of poets who are also teachers but not writers".

So, only Option 1 is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **" Option 1"**.
